description_full: Teck Resources Limited engages in research, exploration, development, processing, smelting, refining, and reclamation of mineral properties in Asia, the Americas, and Europe. It operates through Copper and Zinc segments. The company offers copper, zinc, and lead concentrates, as well as refined zinc, lead, and silver. It also produces lead, precious metals, molybdenum, fertilizers, and other metals; and sells refined metals or concentrates. In addition, it explores for gold. The company was formerly known as Teck Cominco Limited and changed its name to Teck Resources Limited in April 2009. Teck Resources Limited was founded in 1913 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.

financial_summary: Teck Resources Ltd is a large-cap basic materials business with a $29.6B market cap on $7.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -17% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 8% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 34%.
The company is burning through $252M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin 2.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.9% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 2.8% of the shares, and within its sector the business captures 1.6× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
